# Formal Language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:FormalLanguage`](gmeow-FormalLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/FormalLanguage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A grammar-defined language with a machine modality and no human native speakers — programming, markup, query, logic, schema, and configuration languages. A thin structural split from [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md) (the sociolinguistic facets — endonym/exonym, co-mingled scripts, native-speaker status — do not apply), complemented by the [`gmeow:languageOrigin`](../properties/gmeow-languageOrigin.md) value for fine-grained classification.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md)

Use [`gmeow:FormalLanguage`](gmeow-FormalLanguage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a grammar-defined, machine-modality language with no human native speakers — markup, query, logic, schema, or configuration languages — where the sociolinguistic facets of a natural language do not apply.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a natural human language (use [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md)) and, when the language expresses executable computation, prefer the narrower [`gmeow:ProgrammingLanguage`](gmeow-ProgrammingLanguage.md) so [`gmeow:writtenInLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-writtenInLanguage.md) targets are precise.

### How to use

- Type the formal language as [`FormalLanguage`](gmeow-FormalLanguage.md) (or [`ProgrammingLanguage`](gmeow-ProgrammingLanguage.md)), classify it with [`gmeow:languageOrigin`](../properties/gmeow-languageOrigin.md), and skip the endonym/exonym and writing-system-usage machinery that only natural languages need.

### Examples

- ex:langJson a [`gmeow:FormalLanguage`](gmeow-FormalLanguage.md); [`gmeow:languageCode`](../properties/gmeow-languageCode.md) "json".
